interpretation.reference_provenance: Paper describes domain professionals creating tasks/rubrics and scoring three outputs; reviewers approve stages. Public release has one binary fulfilment field per output-criterion, without rater IDs or repeat vectors.
interpretation.repeat_validation: Paper reports 1,127 response-criterion pairs reannotated by two additional experts and Fleiss kappa .912; those individual repeat ratings are not among released fields. This does not establish unanimous/adjudicated truth for every public label.
interpretation.native_target: Positive importance-weighted criterion fulfilment; weights Additional=1, Minor=2, Major=3, Critical=4. All-pass would be a constructed strict full-fulfilment target, not the native headline score.
interpretation.judge_availability: No saved judge predictions in the pinned four-file HF release or nine-file GitHub tree. Existing human labels are not existing independent judge predictions.
interpretation.input_scope: Official judge template receives the saved response and one criterion, not original task prompt, external documents, PDFs or images. Report-generation code supports documents but disables upload for the public release.
interpretation.sampling_scope: Forty base-task clusters across four domains; 120 model-output units are dependent within tasks. A 20/80 split means eight pilot and 32 confirmation clusters, not 24/96 independent tasks.
interpretation.design_recommendation: Useful small human-reference external replication if a new frozen judge run is authorized. Prefer a pre-specified aggregate replication with domain-stratified whole-task grouping; do not transplant the WildIFEval 500-cluster gate or claim a high-powered pilot forecast test.
interpretation.unknowns: No task-pass prevalence or judge error composition checked; long rubrics may make strict passes rare. This is a prospective feasibility concern, not an observed outcome.
interpretation.license: NVIDIA Evaluation Dataset License governs data; repository code MIT. Preserve local sources and publish download/hash instructions before considering redistribution.
